summary: Mixedbread's Starter plan is free and includes $5 in one-time credits — no card required — with 3 workspace users, 10 stores, and 100 requests/minute across its knowledge stack (Toast 1 agent, indexing, semantic/grep search, storage). Every plan bills at the same usage rates. Separately, Mixedbread for startups offers $250 in one-time credits to qualified startups (existing paying users or companies that raised up to $20M from institutional VCs).
claim_steps: Sign up for the free Starter plan at https://www.mixedbread.com/pricing — no card required.
$5 in one-time credits is included; 100 req/min limit.
When credits run out, add credits in billing settings or upgrade to Scale ($20/mo, returned as monthly credits).
